## Problem and intended user

What useful question or workflow does this address?

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest deliverable and explicit non-goals.

## Evidence and evaluation

For experiments, follow docs/03-evaluation/experiment-template.md. Identify labels, baseline, failure cases, and success criteria.

## Data, cost, and safety

State data provenance/permission, whether paid calls are needed, and what actions the application may take. Do not attach secrets or private inputs.
